name: Collapse
description: 折叠面板组件，一个组件四种类型：基础分割型（设置/信息组，右侧 Always Active 绿字或 toggle 开关，折叠指示器用 icon-collapse-plus/minus）/ 行内编辑型（账户信息，预览态⇄编辑态，复用 Input + Button）/ 数据预览型（订单行展开 Order Preview，两种形态：含/不含 Pickup Order 标签）/ 特征导引型（产品特征列表，默认展开首条，前导图标，联动右侧媒体，鼠标悬浮展开）。默认手风琴单开；仅 split 可通过 data-collapse-mode=multiple 显式多开。规范 v2.0。

types.name: split
types.description: 普通信息/设置页的左侧加减号分割堆叠行。右侧业务状态或开关为可选槽，来源没有则省略且不留占位。v3独立FAQ使用右侧Up/Down，不属于当前split精确调用；历史FAQ沿锁定Plan保留。

types.name: inline-edit
types.description: 账户信息管理，预览态显示 label(270px)+值+Edit(icon-edit)，点击展开为编辑态：字段小标签 + Input 输入框 + 帮助文字 + Cancel/Save 按钮。

types.name: data-preview
types.description: 账户中心订单列表行，展开显示 Order Preview 商品缩略图网格。两种形态：形态一含 Pickup Order 浅绿标签，形态二不含。行内含 chevron 箭头、状态 icon-info、View Order、最右侧 icon-more ⋯ 更多。

types.name: feature
types.description: 产品页功能/技术特征列表，默认展开第 1 条（灰底圆角 + 正文），其余收起；鼠标悬浮条目展开，键盘可切换；每条带前导图标，配合右侧图文/视频媒体联动。

usageGuidelines: 默认同一 ds-collapse 组内只允许一个展开项；仅 split 的 data-collapse-mode=multiple 配置允许多开。基础分割型折叠指示器用图标 icon-collapse-plus(收起)/icon-collapse-minus(展开)，右侧业务槽可选：开关用 ds-toggle，只读项用 Always Active；来源没有时不渲染、不留占位。行内编辑型编辑态复用 Input(灰底) + Button（Save 用实心深灰、Cancel 用 outline）。数据预览型有两种形态（含/不含 Pickup Order 标签），状态点复用 Badge ds-badge-dot，状态旁 icon-info 提示，行尾 icon-more 更多菜单，展开箭头 icon-chevron-down 旋转 180°。特征导引型默认展开第 1 条，鼠标悬浮条目展开，键盘 Enter/Space 可切换，前导图标 20px，收起标题灰、展开标题黑。所有类型 hover 整行背景变 #F6F6F8。

relations.notes: 四种类型共享 header/body 骨架，默认单开；仅 split 可显式 multiple，差异集中在右侧插槽与 body 内容。基础分割型折叠指示器改用图标 icon-collapse-plus/minus（规范 v2.0），开关 ds-toggle 为纯 CSS。数据预览型/行内编辑型不是新造子件，而是复用 Badge/Button/Input 组合。特征导引型前导图标当前用库中现有图标占位（icon-placeholder-switch/demo-report/grid-view/list-view/eye），右侧联动媒体在预览页用占位块表示。
relations.splitTriggerRequirement: split 变体的可交互 header 必须是 button.ds-collapse__header，并同步 aria-expanded / aria-controls；组件 CSS 负责清除原生 button 边框与背景。

splitContentSlots.numbering: 编号为 title 内容，不替代 icon-collapse-plus/minus；不得新增编号专属样式变体
splitContentSlots.asideAbsence: 来源没有业务状态/开关时不渲染 aside/always，不留空节点或固定宽度占位

expansionMode.requirement: 仅 split 在来源有多开证据且 Plan 登记时可显式使用 multiple；其他变体保持 single，非法值不得进入页面

componentDependencies.implementationClas.mechanism: check-contracts.js核对宿主具体Button变体和XL尺寸、Input(gray)、Badge(dot)及TextButton(inline-black/L)的真实结构、必需类与current资源；按componentDependencies定向核对。

accordionRule.single-open.mechanism: 现行split/feature/FAQ沿原运行时；inline-edit用真实Input/Button/Edit部件，单字段草稿、回滚及可取消Save；data-preview用独立订单箭头。旧Preview禁用Save和legacy collapse.js仅留历史。
accordionRule.single-open.note: 默认 single；仅 split 显式 data-collapse-mode=multiple 可多开。初始化与点击均同步 class、aria-expanded、body.hidden、aria-hidden 和加减号。

splitStructure.preview-signature.mechanism: check-page-plan-output.js: collapseStructureIssues 检查 split 根节点/item/button/header/title 内加减号、aria-controls→body id、初始状态、显式模式与 Plan 配置；aside 可选，存在时不得为空；verify-component-instances.js 复用该检查

componentDependencies.reuse-badge-btn-in.mechanism: check-contracts.js: componentDependencies 引用的 Button/Input/Badge 及 Badge 的 dot variant 均校验存在

iconDependencies.reused-icons-exist.mechanism: check-contracts.js + generate-preview-tables.js 图标表实时核对 icon-collapse-plus/minus、icon-edit、icon-chevron-down、icon-more、icon-info 及特征前导图标存在

colorDependencies.tokens-exist.mechanism: check-contracts.js: colorDependencies 引用的 color.* token 必须存在于 token-specs/colors.json（缺失即 error），并校验 colors.json 与 tokens.css 的 --color-* 双源值一致（不一致告警）；generate-preview-tables.js 颜色依赖表实时展示色值/存在状态；Guard C 保证声明了 colorDependencies 就必须有颜色依赖表

colorDependencies.css-uses-var.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 2c：切出组件在 components.css 的样式段，校验用到的 var(--color-*) 都在 colorDependencies 声明过，且不出现未声明的裸色值（box-shadow/注释除外），违反即 error —— 保证颜色映射闭环、真·一一对应

radiusDependencies.tokens-exist.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 3a：radiusDependencies 引用的 border-radius.* token 必须存在于 token-specs/border-radius.json（缺失即 error），双源值一致由 validate-tokens.js 全量保证；generate-preview-tables.js 圆角依赖表实时展示；Guard D 保证声明了 radiusDependencies 就必须有圆角依赖表

radiusDependencies.css-uses-var.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 3b：切出组件样式段，校验 border-radius 用到的 var(--border-radius-*) 都在 radiusDependencies 声明过，且不出现未声明的裸圆角值（0 除外），违反即 error —— 保证圆角映射闭环

fontSizeDependencies.tokens-exist.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 4a：fontSizeDependencies 引用的 typography.font-size-* token 必须存在于 token-specs/typography.json（缺失即 error）；token 为 / 表示该字号值无对应正式 token，作白名单登记；generate-preview-tables.js 字号依赖表实时展示；Guard E 保证声明了 fontSizeDependencies 就必须有字号依赖表

fontSizeDependencies.css-uses-var.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 4b：切出组件样式段，校验 font-size 用到的 var(--font-size-*) 都在 fontSizeDependencies 声明过，且不出现未声明的裸字号值（token 为 / 的白名单值除外），违反即 error —— 保证字号映射闭环

shadowDependencies.tokens-exist.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 5a：shadowDependencies 引用的 shadow.* token 必须存在于 token-specs/shadows.json（缺失即 error）；token 为 / 表示该投影值无对应正式 token，作白名单登记；generate-preview-tables.js 投影依赖表实时展示；Guard F 保证声明了 shadowDependencies 就必须有投影依赖表

shadowDependencies.css-uses-var.mechanism: check-contracts.js 检查 5b：切出组件样式段，校验 box-shadow 用到的 var(--shadow-*) 都在 shadowDependencies 声明过，且不出现未声明的裸投影值（none 除外），违反即 error —— 保证投影映射闭环

identity.rule: Every header is a type=button with aria-controls pointing to a globally unique body ID; body hidden/aria-hidden and expanded state agree. Copies must regenerate body IDs and paired controls. Default first item open only. Marker-only data-collapse-current calls; current script guards repeated registration and disabled headers. Exception: data-preview starts all closed and uses its explicitly paired order-toggle only.
identity.labelRule: items preserves header/title icon and body; replace title/body text and regenerate identity as a pair. Optional read-only aside can be omitted for source absence as a declared adaptation; no fake switch.

No invented save action, media synchronization or callback

behavior.initialization: Current runtime requires marker, registers one document delegate set and keeps declared initial hidden/ARIA/icon state. Legacy collapse.js unchanged; do not co-load both.
behavior.split: Header click toggles. Single mode closes peers; only split data-collapse-mode=multiple allows multiple. Icons, aria-expanded and body hidden/aria-hidden update together.
behavior.feature: Mouseover opens a row; pointer-generated click detail!=0 does not toggle. Native keyboard-generated click detail=0 can toggle. No dedicated keydown polyfill; actual keyboard activation remains browser pending.
behavior.events: No dedicated disclosure-change event. Native click bubbles and is not a business-save or media-change signal.
behavior.repeatLoad: Current marker-only runtime has one document guard and delegated listener set. Legacy collapse.js must not be co-loaded; old repeat-binding behavior is not the current contract.
behavior.hosts: Current PC inline-edit and data-preview calls use explicit typed controls and current child atoms. Inline edits support cancel/IME-safe Escape, native validity, cancelable Save intent and local preview commit only.
behavior.nativeStateGuard: Native fieldset/button disabled, hidden item/ancestor and ARIA-disabled header/ancestor block synthetic activation and feature hover without discarding open state. Availability restoration permits subsequent operation; no hidden disclosure mutation.
behavior.editAtom: Preview-only Edit delegates structure, font, paint, icon dimensions and hover to TextButton inline-black/L. The host owns only placement and paired disclosure events. Original 16px icon differs from current 12px atom; use user-confirmed atom-first policy, preserve source difference. No new exact action variant or Save behavior.
behavior.sourceV3Boundary: Retained FAQ six source rows are composed by the existing faq call; source variants remain evidence, not independent business calls. Source arrows, first/middle/last borders and hidden state stay source-owned. Visual approval and M/Pad are separate.
behavior.cookiesHotZone1014: Readonly finite split uses paragraph copy-region; click inside stays open and text is selectable, body padding/item blank closes. Header keyboard/click and authored single/multiple semantics retained. Missing source marker or paragraph region rejected; no Switch upgrade.

behavior.faq: Native button activation; all closed initially, single-open, first/middle/last source padding/divider and up/down SVGs; answers remain inside true row, copy does not toggle. No image/map/business linkage.
behavior.dataPreview: Current MG v3.1 finite PC order snapshot; explicit arrow/native Enter/Space toggles, single-open. View/info/more emit action/orderId only; no whole-row toggle, popup or backend promise. Both Pickup/no-Pickup source forms retained. Fixed PC row is internally scrollable on narrow host; no M call.
behavior.inlineEdit: All closed initially; one open field at a time, opening another cancels prior draft. Cancel/Escape rollback/refocus; composing Escape/submit do not commit. Save uses form validity and bubbles cancelable ds:collapse-save {field,values}; preventDefault keeps editor open. Without cancellation, local display is updated; no server persistence promised.
